slots.prompt: Generate one substantive Kartenweg game-art style study, exactly 1280x360 pixels. Use these actual tavern/garden images as material-detail, atmosphere and pixel-cluster references, but change the camera to strict genuine overhead top-down with no horizon, sky, or isometric view. Night garden/woodland route behind the tavern. Left: rich old slate paving, weathered timber, warm amber lantern return, connected ground at (100,325). Middle: continuous winding walkable path amid irregular richly clustered tree canopies, moss and restrained lush plants. Right: open meadow edge, stone and unlettered wooden hill-route waymarker; connected ground at (1180,325). Different left/right compositions, continuous center; trees/walls can be obstacles outside the path. Cool slate/teal moonlight, tiny warm light islands, chipped stone, woodgrain, intentional crisp coherent pixels and full material detail comparable to attached actual approved rooms. No vector triangles, generic geometric demo scenery, soft painting, blur, bloom or photo grain. No characters, text, labels, UI, captions, grids, frames, watermark. One continuous full-frame raster concept, not final game production art.

Create ONE canonical genuine strict overhead top-down pixel-art character concept of Mara, the SAME woman shown in the attached adventure character sheet. Attached sheet is IDENTITY reference only, not pose or camera. Newly draw her from vertically above; do NOT rotate, squash, copy or compress the adventure sprite. Dark brown compact angular bob hair, burgundy jacket over a small visible light blouse, teal trousers and brown boots, slender shoulders. View the crown of head, tops of shoulders/arms and foreshortened clothing/feet from real overhead, facing toward bottom of image. Do not show a large front-facing portrait face or standing adventure side view. Preserve her identity via distinctive bob shape and large burgundy/light/teal color clusters. Crisp materially developed expressive adventure pixel art matching the attached real original, deliberate coherent pixel clusters and restrained 3-5 tones per material, cool ambient slate/teal light, subtle warm skin. Must remain distinct and readable when reduced into a 32px target frame; prioritize strong silhouette and clothing color masses, not tiny noisy detail. ONE neutral standing concept only, no walk cycle, no sprite sheet, no extra views or duplicates. No backdrop, floor, cast ground shadow, grid, text, captions, frame, UI, watermark, blur, bloom or photo noise. Transparent background, never fake checkerboard/white/black alpha.
